Class ProductServer

java.lang.Object
com.robuschi.ProductServer
public class ProductServer extends Object

The ProductServer class is a multithreaded server for handling online product sales.

Manages user authentication, product inventory, client requests and server responses.

Author:
Mattia Robuschi Caprara

  • Constructor Details

    • ProductServer

      public ProductServer()

      Creates a new ProductServer instance with initial users and products.

      It initializes a thread-safe map for storing users.

      Creates a thread-safe list for products by wrapping an ArrayList with a synchronized wrapper.

      Initializes a thread pool that dynamically creates new threads as needed and reuses idle threads.

      Creates a thread-safe list for tracking connected clients.

      It also sets the default users and populate the product list with some items.

    • broadcastProductList

      private void broadcastProductList()

      Broadcasts product list update to all connected clients.

      Used especially for the ListView refresh in the client, so when there is a change in the product inventory it gets immediately displayed.

    • getConnectedUsernames

      private String getConnectedUsernames()

      Gets a comma-separated list of connected user's usernames.

      Returns:
      string with all connected usernames or the string: No active clients if there are no active clients.
